summary: Charles Smith of Garden Ridge, Texas died after slipping on a scree field below Heckert Pass on a nine-day expedition with Devin McKay; McKay saw him roll down and over the ridgeline and triggered a Garmin inReach SOS. 23 Mountain Rescue Aspen members + a Colorado Army National Guard helicopter responded; an MRA drone located the body between Heckert Pass and Pierre Lakes Basin; hoist recovery to the Pitkin County Medical Examiner.
location: below Heckert Pass, between Heckert Pass and Pierre Lakes Basin
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Colorado Army National Guard; Pitkin County Sheriff's Office
